name: DIANOIA
source:
Yuki Yamashita visits Frigg to learn more about its urban legend.
Outside an unfamiliar residence a voice beckons.
She enters without aim or intention.
Yuki meets two young girls, Annelinsey and Tamako, who introduce her
to Erika Fushimi, born of the dream world into this residence.
Yuki is now responsible for this girl.
Can they escape the dream? Or will Yuki join these girls in eternity here...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ120900.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
山下由纪为了调查城市传说来到弗丽格。
陌生宅邸外，有声音在呼唤她。
她漫无目的地走了进去。
由纪遇见了两个小女孩安内琳茜与玉子，她们向她介绍了出生于梦境世界、降临这座宅邸的伏见绘里香。
如今，由纪必须负责照顾这个女孩。
她们能逃离梦境吗？还是由纪会永远留在这里，与女孩们相伴……

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ120900.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
